params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $relay=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; $origin=(git -C $relay remote get-url origin).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('hcp-main-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); git clone --quiet --branch main --single-branch $origin $tmp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; try { $sha=(git -C $tmp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if($sha -ne '448ad1f7f60783780474c2c27cc5b2592a599cc8'){ throw ('main moved before gate: '+$sha) }; Set-Location $tmp; python .\plugins\heaven-control-plane\verify.py; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python .\heaven-bridge\test_worker.py; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python .\heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git diff --check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output ('EXACT_MAIN_VERIFIED='+$sha) } finally { Set-Location $HOME; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
